extra.text: The north ladder flexes above the cobbles. Deliver four bundles of reinforced fibers before a lamplighter learns to fly.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Bind them dry and keep them clean of lamp oil.

decline.text: A wise refusal if heights trouble you. We will brace it from the ground.

in_progress.text: Four bundles will brace the rungs and the crew's courage.

ready.text: These fibers have backbone. Put them by the repair bench.

extra.text: Tomorrow's climb will be uneventful. That is the finest sort of climb.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
